claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The drivetrain (shifter and derailleur) may be missing or broken.
risks.proof: A video showing the bike being pedaled through all gears.

risks.risk: The rear suspension may be damaged or stiff.
risks.proof: A video showing the rear wheel being pushed and released.
A video of the bike being ridden with the brakes applied.

risks.risk: The wheels may have hidden cracks or uneven wear.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rims and tires.
risks.if_unproven: as having worn or damaged wheels

proof_requests: Video of the bike being pedaled through all gears to confirm the drivetrain works.
Close-up photos of the rear suspension and the rear wheel to check for damage.
Video of the bike being ridden with the brakes applied.
Close-up photos of the tires and rims.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
